curation.notes: Two techniques: (1) custom permanent-magnet magnetic tweezers DNA-bridging assay on branched/unbranched 4292 bp DNA, cycling between 4 pN and 0.1 pN in the presence of WT and variant human CtIP (4 or 20 nM); (2) LUMICKS C-Trap dual-trap optical tweezers with confocal imaging of Bio-CtIP-AF635 diffusion on 25,427 bp DNA held at 15 pN (buffer 20 mM HEPES pH 7.8, 100 mM KCl, 5 mM MgCl2, PCA/PCD oxygen scavenger). Hardware/assay/solution below describe the magnetic tweezers assay.
